summary: Implementation plan for complete technical and on-page SEO optimization of DSCWeb, including a centralized SEO registry, enhanced usePageMeta hook, build-time static HTML route shell prerendering for crawlers, Schema.org JSON-LD graph (Organization, WebSite, Person, WebPage, SoftwareApplication), cleaned sitemap.xml and robots.txt, legacy .html 301 redirects, and automated SEO validation tests.
